decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core postpress portfolio and has its own product page, so it fits established distribution and service routines, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses.

The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core offer, which makes its results more uncertain, but it is a flagship with a German premiere event, and growing industry turnover gives the firm slack to carry it while it builds a track record.
The sheet preparation module builds on the existing modular systems and adds to sales of complete lines, so its low cost of carrying and strategic fit mean there is no reason to drop it.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship close to the core business and features on the home page, so it matches the firm's push toward automated workflows and is very likely to meet aspirations.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the established booklet-making offer and has its own page, so it fits existing customer demand and service capabilities with little pressure to drop it.
The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and already has a documented customer installation combined with the Touchline line, which shows results in line with aspirations.
